Read input: write_pointer_combined.v · Open raw
module write_pointer(
    wptr, fifo_we, wr, fifo_full, clk, rst_n
);

  input wr, fifo_full, clk, rst_n;
  output[4:0] wptr;
  output fifo_we;
  reg[4:0] wptr;

  assign fifo_we = (~fifo_full) & wr;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if(~rst_n)
        wptr <= 5'b00000;
    else if(fifo_we)
        wptr <= wptr + 5'b00001;
  end

endmodule
